purpose: Shakti-gated acquisition queue for current-round auction/process documents that are not safely inferable from the IBBI auction register alone.
rule: A process document may enter decision evidence only after exact debtor + auction round + document version are verified and its bytes are hashed.
sourceHierarchy: Exact current-round process/tender document issued by liquidator or hosted by the corporate debtor
IBBI auction record and auction notice for exact-round identity
BAANKNET current-lot record where publicly accessible
User-provided document uploaded through AssetShakti evidence intake when public retrieval is unavailable

requiredEvidence: current E-Auction Process Information Document / detailed tender terms
financial-assets/securities scope if included or excluded
requests.fallback: Request the exact 07-10-2026 process document from the liquidator / BAANKNET and upload the original PDF.

requiredEvidence: current title/UDS schedules and data-room references
requests.fallback: If the public copy changes, upload the exact version supplied by the liquidator/BAANKNET.

requiredEvidence: current Edathala-only E-Auction Process Information Document / tender terms
requests.fallback: Request the exact 10-10-2026 Edathala process document from the liquidator / BAANKNET and upload the original PDF. Do not inherit the 17-04-2026 multi-parcel package.
Request the exact 01-10-2026 lot document from the liquidator / BAANKNET and upload the original PDF. Do not merge the 29-09-2026 commercial-premises round.
Request the exact 23-09-2026 process bundle from the liquidator / BAANKNET and upload the original PDFs. Reconcile the recorded corrigendum before decision use.

requiredEvidence: current process/tender document applicable to the selected option
lease document for Option 3 / Block B-(2)
handover/removal terms for Option 2 / Block B-(1)
requests.fallback: Upload the exact process document and option-specific supporting documents supplied by the liquidator / BAANKNET. Preserve Options 1, 2 and 3 as separate lots.

failClosed: Register metadata cannot substitute for a detailed process document.
Historical-round documents cannot satisfy a current-round requirement unless explicitly reconciled.
A public URL is a discovery reference until the exact bytes are acquired, hashed and identity-verified.
No title, possession, valuation or bidder-eligibility conclusion may be promoted from this queue alone.
